title.text: Terrain tools, redone for voxels — design round of 2026-09-19

how.text: PROPOSED, not decided, except: surface verbs stay and block editing is added; a new face's paint is a choice on the tool (both logged 2026-09-19); the selection drives the terrain tools, and the selection tools come first (the owner, 2026-09-20). REDRAWN 2026-09-21 around the selection: the Rule board and the Questions board. The other boards are as first drawn, to draw on one verb at a time. Comment on any board and send it to Claude.

selTitle.text: The selection tools, mapped out — design pass of 2026-09-20

selHow.text: PROPOSED. Built already (2026-09-20): Region mode, the three elements, brush / rect / fill, surface / through, combine, grow / shrink / invert. This pass maps the rest: specialised selections for each element, kept simple as three gestures and one Match menu.
